historical_replay_acceptance: Read-only source/runtime/library/build hashes equal the registered input identities before any sampling and before accepting each checkpoint.
Each new directory is empty at first launch. No original checkpoint/settings/report is rewritten or fed as a mutable resume target.
New settings dictionary differs from its exact old dictionary only at snapshot_interval,0to100. Fingerprints of both dictionaries are checked separately.
Load both checkpoints with expected_kind=h3.surface-partition and require_integrity=True. Whole old checkpoint SHA must still equal its report and input-audit receipt.

Every one of the16 old non-snapshot payload arrays has exactly equal key, dtype, shape and C-order bytes in the replay. This includes radius,ratio,eta_R,eta_r,completed,delta_energy,diagnostics,acceptance,swap,lineage,traversal counters,domain_sha256 and the exact RNG string. No float tolerance replaces byte equality.
The only differing checkpoint arrays are fingerprint,endpoint_q,endpoint_completed_sweeps. New endpoints have shape(200,256,3,3) and exact fixed sweep indices2100..22000by100.
Original and replay reference.json and reference-domain.json raw bytes must match exactly. Domain normalization is never recomputed into a different accepted identity.
Report analysis and all physical/source settings match the original. Elapsed/creation metadata, new checkpoint hash and declared snapshot-count fields may change explicitly.

Each saved parent is finite, on r01=r12<=r02 within1e-10bohr, beadwise minimum pair>=0.5bohr within1e-12, and beadwise total COM zero within1e-10bohr. No PES gradient or Maxwell momentum is claimed to have been archived.
Rehash all original inputs after replay and verification. A source, data or RNG mismatch is a failed replay, not a new acceptable seed.

Each of the4old chains must reproduce all16original non-snapshot payload arrays byte-for-byte and its original analysis/reference/domain identities. The old4chain assessment is never overwritten by the new8chain assessment.
new_chain_acceptance: Each new seed starts in its own empty directory with the exact predeclared settings above, the same frozen sampler/runtime and PES bytes; no historical raw/RNG state is reused.
Integrity-bound settings, reference-domain hash, all22000completed sweeps,20000x9delta-energy observations,2000x9x8diagnostics and200parent snapshots are required.
Full provenance, restart RNG and move/swap/lineage counters are preserved, including incomplete/failure states.
Apply the same finite-geometry, active-centroid-surface, bead-domain and zero-COM checks to every saved parent.
Apply the preexisting sampling flags to every chain. These flags remain diagnostic/gating requirements; a failed seed is not replaced, omitted, shortened or rerun until favorable.

scheduling_proposal.CPU_affinity: one recorded available CPU per child; process-isolated PES; no concurrent threads sharing Fortran common state
scheduling_proposal.budget_or_failure: preserve all states/logs/failedoutcomes; stop admissions and drain; record incomplete/failed and nochildeligibility. No seed substitution or stopping at4based onestimatedrates.
